title: The offer changed. The bot lied.

vo: Monday. You send fifty percent off, to five thousand customers.
Wednesday. You change the offer to thirty.
Thursday. A Monday customer asks about their fifty percent. A generic bot says thirty. Now you have an angry customer, and a screenshot.
Spandan saves the exact message each customer received, at send time. So their answer stays true, to what you promised them.
Would your bot pass this test? Comment below.
